import hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,sys,time,threading
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('verification/part2/supervise_p21_resume.py')
assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='4d38c8046cdc43d01b5d00d67d3c5bcd34244d581ab6fa6bde545724a7fb8ff7'
sys.path.insert(0,str(p.parent.resolve()));import supervise_p21_resume as s
s.identity();s.sparse_state()
print('P21_RECONNECTED_BEFORE',json.dumps({'head':s.git('rev-parse','HEAD'),'disk_free':shutil.disk_usage(s.ROOT).free}),flush=True)
head=s.update(require_sparse=True);assert head
assert hashlib.sha256(s.TARGETS.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='1270ee99d3b5ae64a21d54a809665eb5eeae9a58ba3db7e11b35afffff964086'
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('ImbalancedChen/P2HistoricLogPointInterpreter.lean').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='492a9c12ae0f8819a1c5eebb8cc2ff70665d7395cfef4e68f8fe352fd54b3442'
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('ImbalancedChen/P2HistoricSieveStateInduction.lean').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='46a4c46db1ebea7064b041cae0e2c37ffd859ac972de9e709c5229f1ddca5b88'
groups,roots,_,_=s.selection()
helper=Path('verification/part2/extend_p21_buchstab_native_snapshot.py')
assert hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='af9b5397ae5ade235a2875354d7d0f24f811719bb2c7201a84128c3fbac82bd6'
out=s.PRIVATE/'p21-buchstab-native'/s.BASE_SHA/s.sha(helper)
def inventory():
 return {'providers':[str(x.relative_to(out)) for x in sorted((out/'providers').glob('*.json'))], 'runs':[str(x.relative_to(out)) for x in sorted((out/'runs').glob('*'))], 'probes':[str(x.relative_to(out)) for x in sorted((out/'probes').glob('*/*.log'))], 'final':[n for n in ['EXTERNAL_SNAPSHOT.json','QUALIFICATION.json'] if (out/n).is_file()]}
print('P21_INTERRUPTED_NATIVE_INVENTORY',json.dumps(inventory()),flush=True)
snaps=s.snapshots()
if snaps[1] is None:
 argv=[sys.executable,str(helper),'--snapshot',str(s.BASE),'--snapshot-sha256',s.BASE_SHA]
 print('P21_ORIGINAL_QUALIFICATION_RESUME',json.dumps(argv),flush=True)
 proc=subprocess.Popen(argv)
 while True:
  try:code=proc.wait(timeout=30);break
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:print('P21_NATIVE_PROGRESS',json.dumps(inventory()),flush=True)
 print('P21_ORIGINAL_QUALIFICATION_EXIT',code,flush=True)
 if code:raise SystemExit(code)
 snaps=s.snapshots();assert all(snaps)
else:
 print('P21_EXISTING_CONTROLLED_EXTENSION_FOUND',str(snaps[1]),flush=True)
from winner9_external_snapshot import ExternalSnapshot
import run_winner9_private_audit as audit
for snap in snaps:
 ext=ExternalSnapshot(snap,lean=audit.LEAN,mathlib_pin=audit.PIN,project_lib=s.LIB)
 ext.verify()
 print('P21_NATIVE_SNAPSHOT_VERIFIED',str(snap),ext.raw_sha256,len(ext.modules),flush=True)
print('P21_RECONNECTED_NATIVE_READY',json.dumps({'head':head,'snapshots':[str(x) for x in snaps],'native_modules':[515,518],'compile_credit':False,'kernel_credit':False,'node_complete':False}),flush=True)
